newsitem.title: UK: ONS says no obvious stg impact on UK output.
newsitem.headline: ONS says no obvious stg impact on UK output.

text.p: There is "no obvious effect" from the strength of sterling in the June manufacturing output data, a spokesman for the Office for National Statistics said on Tuesday.
"Manufacturing is down from its peak, but output is still high," he said.

UK manufacturing output grew by 0.4 percent in June compared with May but fell by 0.1 percent in the latest three months, compared with the previous three months. Output levels were 1.6 percent higher than the second quarter of 1996.
